title: KLEAR: Knowledge-Matched LLM Evaluation in Korean across Application Requirements via Controlled Benchmark Transformation
abstract: arXiv:2611.09223v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing Korean benchmarks for Large Language Models (LLMs) evaluate performance across diverse knowledge domains, but their accuracy scores cannot distinguish whether incorrect responses arise from a lack of required knowledge or a failure to apply that knowledge correctly. Our analysis of existing Korean benchmarks reveals that most questions can be answered through factual recall alone, while those demanding greater application also differ in required knowledge, making it difficult to isolate application ability. To address this, we introduce KLEAR, a framework that constructs knowledge-matched contrasts by varying application demand while preserving the required knowledge. During construction, KLEAR identifies the knowledge underlying each source question as an explicit anchor bundle to guide generation of questions requiring more complex application. translated_title: KLEAR：通过受控基准转换在韩语中进行跨应用需求的知识匹配大语言模型评估
translated_abstract: 现有的韩语大语言模型（LLM）基准测试评估了模型在多个知识领域的性能，但其准确率分数无法区分错误回答是由于缺乏所需知识还是未能正确应用该知识。我们对现有韩语基准测试的分析表明，大多数问题仅通过事实回忆即可回答，而那些需要更强应用能力的问题在所需知识方面也存在差异，这使得难以单独评估模型的应用能力。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了KLEAR，这是一个通过在保持所需知识不变的前提下改变应用需求来构建知识匹配对比基准的框架。在构建过程中，KLEAR将每个源问题背后的知识识别为显式的锚点集合，用以指导生成需要更复杂应用能力的问题。生成的候选问题随后经过自动化和人工验证，并进行迭代式的重新（修正）。
tldr: KLEAR是一个韩语LLM评估框架，通过在保持所需知识不变的情况下改变应用需求来构建知识匹配的对比基准，从而能够区分模型的错误回答究竟源于知识缺乏还是应用能力不足。
en_tdlr: KLEAR is a Korean LLM evaluation framework that constructs knowledge-matched contrast benchmarks by varying application demand while preserving required knowledge, enabling the distinction between errors caused by lack of knowledge versus failure to correctly apply knowledge.
